---
title: "Authentication"
description: "Credentials and scopes for the Bouncr API."
---

Use `https://api.bouncr.io` with an organization API credential in the `Authorization: Bearer …` header.

| Scope | Access |
| --- | --- |
| `scans:create` | Create scans in authorized venues. |
| `scans:capture` | Include capture initialization when creating a scan, or issue a new capture token. |
| `scans:read` | Retrieve a scan and its available results. |
| `scans:list` | List scans in authorized venues. |

Organization credentials stay on your backend. Pass the scan’s capture token and configuration to the SDK.

Scan and venue IDs are strings. Error responses may have no body.
